material: Accepted simple blue translucent glowing gel; unchanged
baseMotion: The accepted V1 springs, in the gel engine's render/gel/motion.cpp
boundaries: All 42 canonical mood IDs retained; no graph edge or state schema changes.
Two named face alternates are preview expression IDs, not new moods.
Emotion acting and surface drag are additive review candidates outside locked V1 source blocks.
Procedural graphics only; no saved face textures, model assets, backend, speech or sound changes.
Reference face language is interpreted; accessories and colors are not copied.
New face art is a V3 review candidate, not accepted production artwork.

designSystem.identity: Soft rounded slime face, inspired by the supplied kawaii/Rimuru-like facial language; original blue gel body retained.
designSystem.facePlacement: Individual low-set, broad eye rows with compact eye-to-mouth spacing.
designSystem.strokes: Cubic/quadratic brush curves, rounded ends and joins; no thin angular scaffold brows.
designSystem.eyes: Pupil-free eggs, bean lids, pinched curves or reference-specific pale water/cloud shapes.
designSystem.mouths: Small smooth w/pout/ring silhouettes, simple U for happy and a wide bean laugh for excited.
designSystem.cheeks: Visible soft oval blush and rounded hatching; selected cheek freckles or stress strokes.
designSystem.tears: Soft translucent blue ribbons with short broken highlights; not bright straight stripes.
designSystem.changes: All 44 faces individually redrawn and given per-face eye spacing, eye height, mouth position and cheek treatment.
designSystem.preserved: 42 mood IDs, 19 reference mappings, three existing gesture recipes per expression, blue gel material, drag extension and seven accepted V1 motion blocks.
